newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes thrust higher, ending week with rally - 8/11.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes thrust higher, ending week with rally - 8/11.

text.p: U.S. crudes tracked higher Friday, staging a rally to end the week in bullish price territory despite sentiment the market remained bearish.
Outright cash prices followed in-line with the NYMEX push. Traders said weather forecasts for a cold snap in the northeastern United States was the main trigger behind buying.
"There was definitely a technical aspect to the rally, but it was the weather mostly," said a Texas crude trader.
Dec West Texas Intermediate/Cushing ended at $23.55-65 a barrel, around 85 cts higher than Thursday's close.
Dec/Jan backwardation ended at around 20 cts, pressuring the Dec Postings Plus/Cushing market.
